title: The Higgs Boson and the Standard Model
text: The Higgs boson is an elementary particle in the Standard Model of particle physics, produced by quantum excitation of the Higgs field. The Higgs field is a quantum field that permeates all of space and gives mass to elementary particles through their interaction with it. The existence of the Higgs boson was predicted in 1964 by physicist Peter Higgs and others. Its discovery was announced on July 4, 2012, by scientists at CERN using the Large Hadron Collider, confirming a key prediction of the Standard Model. Peter Higgs and François Englert were awarded the Nobel Prize in Physics in 2013 for their theoretical work on the mechanism.
